flows.name: Overview query
steps: Resolve explicit Customer/period scope
Read accepted projections/revisions from owning domains
Compute Tickets/Objectives/Inventory/SLA/Communication/Infrastructure summaries
Preserve unknown/partial/stale/excluded/unresolved markers
Build Needs Attention and deterministic narrative
Return as-of/freshness/coverage metadata with navigable source identities

flows.name: Needs Attention
steps: Collect owning-domain actionable warning/proposal/review/blocker projections
Exclude resolved/non-actionable/decorative conditions
Apply deterministic priority/tie rules selected in LLD
Preserve source domain/target/reason/age/coverage
Navigate action to owning domain rather than mutating from Overview cache

flows.name: Operational narrative
steps: Select accepted today/near-term events and action-required facts
Order by deterministic temporal/priority rules
Render human-readable statements from typed templates
Expose target navigation and unknown chronology explicitly
Never persist narrative text as operational authority

flows.name: Projection refresh
steps: Observe committed domain revisions/events
Recompute or invalidate affected disposable read models
Publish new projection revision/as-of
If refresh fails retain known prior projection only with explicit stale state
Never roll back or alter owning-domain transactions

summary_rules: Ticket counts use accepted lifecycle/state filters and retain terminal history where governed.
Objective counts/timeline distinguish plan, execution, review and excluded historical populations.
Inventory summarizes constituent Needs/requests/RMAs/returns/warehouse/action-required state without flattening mixed outcomes.
SLA summary keeps individual SR state distinct from monthly cohort state and immutable report snapshots.
Communication summary uses canonical links/coverage and never counts unsent MSG drafts as sent interaction.
